title: The cat and the cardboard box
summary: One start picture and one detailed prompt turned into a 10-second comedy.

scenes.prompt:
3D Pixar-style cartoon animation, bright friendly colors, expressive characters. Maintain the exact art style, characters, lighting and layout of the starting frame.

Create ONE fast, snappy 10-second vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D cartoon comedy video.

Use the supplied image as the EXACT first frame. Preserve its character designs, sunny living-room lighting, furniture and existing mess. Continue directly from that image.

STORY:
Noob decides to trap the cat and rat using a sandwich beneath a cardboard box propped up on a stick. The rat steals the sandwich. Noob crawls beneath the raised box to retrieve the empty plate. The cat pulls the string attached to the support stick, dropping the box over Noob. Cat and rat happily share the sandwich on top while Noob’s green legs kick beneath it.

CHARACTER LOCK:
Exactly ONE yellow blocky Noob: yellow cube head and block hands, blue rectangular torso, green block legs, same face and proportions as the reference.
No realistic fingers, hair, accessories or clothing changes.

Exactly ONE orange striped cat with white muzzle.
Exactly ONE small gray rat with pink ears and thin pink tail.
Keep both animals identical to the reference.
No duplicate characters.

PROPS AND PHYSICAL LOGIC:
ONE large lightweight cardboard box.
ONE wooden support stick.
ONE string tied securely to the support stick.
ONE sandwich on ONE plate.

Box sits on the rug with its open side facing downward.
One edge is raised by the support stick.
Sandwich and plate sit beneath the raised opening.
Pulling the string removes the stick and drops the box straight down.
Box never slides across the room or teleports.
Noob must visibly crawl beneath it BEFORE it drops.

0–1 SECOND — REVENGE IDEA
Start exactly from the supplied image.
Noob looks toward the happy cat and rat.
His worried face changes into a quick sneaky grin.
He rubs his block hands together once.

Camera pushes toward his face.
SFX: short idea DING, hand rub.

1–3 SECONDS — TRAP REVEAL
Hard cut within the same living room to a close three-quarter view of the prepared trap.

Noob finishes placing the sandwich plate beneath the raised box.
Show the box, support stick and attached string clearly.
He immediately retreats behind the sofa holding the string.

Do not animate a lengthy construction sequence.
This cut compresses the setup time.
Existing room mess remains visible.

Camera briefly tracks from sandwich to support stick, then toward hiding Noob.
SFX: plate TAP, cardboard rustle, quick footsteps.

3–4.5 SECONDS — THEY SEE THROUGH IT
Cat and rat approach the sandwich.
They look at the bait, then exchange one quick mischievous glance.

Rat immediately darts beneath the raised box, grabs the whole sandwich and runs out.
Plate stays beneath the box.
Cat remains outside beside the support stick.

Camera stays low, keeping bait and trap opening readable.
SFX: tiny pawbeats, bread rustle, quick ZIP.

4.5–6.5 SECONDS — NOOB ENTERS HIS OWN TRAP
Noob sees the rat escaping with the sandwich.
His grin becomes annoyed surprise.

He drops his end of the string onto the rug and rushes to the trap.
He kneels and crawls headfirst beneath the raised box to reach the empty plate.

Show his yellow head and blue torso entering beneath the box.
His green legs remain outside the opening.

Cat approaches the loose string.
Rat waits safely outside holding the sandwich.

Camera side-tracks with Noob, keeping the support stick visible.
SFX: quick Noob footsteps, knee THUMP, clothing rustle.

6.5–8 SECONDS — TRAP BACKFIRES
Cat grips the loose string and gives ONE sharp backward tug.

String pulls the support stick free.
Box drops straight down over Noob’s head and torso.
Only his green legs stick out beneath the edge.

Quick impact camera shake.
No injury, crushing detail or realistic violence.
The box is lightweight and the impact is harmless slapstick.

SFX: string TWANG, stick CLACK, cardboard WHUMP.

8–10 SECONDS — FINAL LAUGH
Cat hops onto the closed top of the box.
Rat climbs up carrying the same sandwich.

They sit together and each takes a small bite.
They exchange ONE quick paw high-five.

Below them, Noob’s green legs kick twice in frustration.
Box wobbles slightly but stays in place.

Camera pulls back enough to show happy animals, sandwich, box and kicking legs together.
End on the paw high-five and final frustrated kick.
No additional TV reveal.

SFX: soft landing taps, two tiny CRUNCH sounds, paw TAP, muffled foot THUMPS.

PACING:
Fast physical actions with readable cause and effect.
No slow motion.
No prolonged thinking, staring or celebration.
No repeated actions or long trap-building montage.
Expressions change during movement.
Use clean hard cuts, no fades or black frames.

AUDIO:
SFX ONLY.
No dialogue, voiceover, narrator, speech, vocal reactions, singing or music.

STRICT:
No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
No extra characters.
No portals or TV effects.
No character redesign.
Keep existing room mess consistent.
Rat exits the trap before Noob enters.
Cat stays outside until the box drops.
Noob is physically under the box before impact.
Cat pulls the support stick using the attached string.
Sandwich remains with the rat after theft.
Final shot clearly shows Noob losing while cat and rat enjoy his sandwich.

Narration voice: a warm, sunny female narrator.

Playful, upbeat background music.

No text overlays, no logos, no watermarks.
